paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the exploration of hyperparameters by showing the relationship between the parameter $\alpha$ and accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "$\alpha$" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 5, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and employs a linear scale with a visible range from approximately 22.70 to 23.75, with numeric tick labels placed at intervals of 0.25. The plot displays a single solid teal line with circular markers, identified in the legend as "Dolly." The line begins at an accuracy of 22.70 at approximately x = 0.1 and experiences a sharp increase to reach a peak accuracy of 23.70 at x = 0.5. Following this peak, the line declines to 23.40 at x = 1.0 and then follows a steady downward trend, ending at an accuracy of 22.70 at x = 5.0.
